text:
Rita: Alex from VortexPay just submitted their security packet (SIG export) and asked for a short POC that processes tokenized payment IDs. They requested EU-only processing + BYOK. Link: https://files.redwood.example/vortexpay/sig_export.pdf
DeployBot: File stored at secure-bucket://intake/vortexpay/3460001234/sig.pdf (sha256: d41d8...) :white_check_mark:
Alex (VortexPay): Confirming scope: POC uses tokenized IDs only, no PAN. Goal: validate latency and integration. POC window: 10 business days. EU-only processing required.
Priya (Security): I need network diagram, exact PII fields, and which CAIQ questions they left blank. Also confirm hosted vs dedicated vs private.
Tom (SE): If they want BYOK + EU-only, hosted with customer-managed keys is possible but legal will likely require a DPA. For Dedicated we'll need lead time for capacity. Ask them expected QPS and latency SLA.
Alex (VortexPay): Expected steady QPS ~8/s, spikes to 40/s. p95 target < 250ms. Context length small (~1k tokens).
Rita: I'll collect artifacts. Alex, please upload the network diagram and anonymized token samples to s3://redwood-secure/intake/vortexpay/3460001234/ and grant access to redwood/sec-team and eng-se.
Priya (Security): Assigned to me for CAIQ review. I'll mark controls we own as "redwood-inference" and call out anything blocking. EU-only and BYOK = legal + DPA likely.
LegalBot: DPA required when customer-managed keys or EU-only processing requested. Opening legal ticket #LEGAL-2026.
Tom (SE): Quick pricing note for Rita: short Dedicated (2xA10) for the POC + support ~ $5k-8k for two weeks; hosted with BYOK pricing lower but depends on keys/legal. I'll drop a calc sheet in the share.
Alex (VortexPay): Can retention on logs be limited to 30 days? Compliance prefers shorter retention for the POC.
Priya (Security): We can propose 30-day log retention for the POC; will document in CAIQ answers.
Rita: Scheduling kickoff for Wednesday 9am CET to review dataflow, key onboarding, and timeline. Priya + Tom + legal rep invited.
Alex (VortexPay): 9am CET works. We'll upload artifacts by EOD today.
DeployBot: Intake ticket #SF-4999 created and linked to this thread.
Priya (Security): I'll start the questionnaire pass and post a short checklist before the call.
Rita: Thanks everyone, updating CRM to "security: intake -> assigned".
